parsed.name: Wasatch 光谱仪设备封装组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于在控制器与 Wasatch 光谱仪采集线程之间建立队列通信。它负责连接底层设备对象、等待或轮询光谱仪设置、转发参数变更、接收光谱读数与状态消息，并管理断开与重置流程，常用于光谱数据采集界面的异步控制。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that mediates queue-based communication between a controller and a Wasatch spectrometer acquisition thread. It connects the low-level device object, waits for or polls spectrometer settings, forwards setting changes, receives spectra and status messages, and manages reset and disconnect flow for asynchronous spectroscopy control.

actions.description: 连接底层 Wasatch 光谱仪对象并启动连续轮询子线程。
actions.description_en: Connect the underlying Wasatch spectrometer object and start the continuous polling child thread.

actions.description: 等待子线程返回初始化后的光谱仪设置信息。
actions.description_en: Wait for the child thread to return initialized spectrometer settings.

actions.description: 轮询是否已有可用的光谱仪设置信息。
actions.description_en: Poll for availability of spectrometer settings.

actions.description: 重置该封装组件的连接或内部状态。
actions.description_en: Reset the wrapper component's connection or internal state.

actions.description: 断开连接并向子线程发送停止信号。
actions.description_en: Disconnect and send a termination signal to the child thread.

actions.description: 从状态队列中获取来自光谱仪线程的状态消息。
actions.description_en: Acquire a status message from the spectrometer thread's status queue.

actions.description: 向封装流程发送指定设置和值的提醒或通知。
actions.description_en: Send an alert or notification with the specified setting and value through the wrapper flow.

actions.description: 从响应队列获取最新的光谱读数或采集数据。
actions.description_en: Acquire the latest spectral reading or acquisition data from the response queue.

actions.description: 将光谱仪设置变更加入控制队列并转发到底层设备。
actions.description_en: Queue a spectrometer setting change and forward it to the underlying device.

actions.description: 获取响应队列中的最终数据项。
actions.description_en: Get the final item from the response queue.
